verses.sloka: तां श्रुत्वा करुणां वाचं पितुर्मरणसंहिताम् ।राघवो भरतेनोक्तां बभूव गतचेतन: ॥ २.१०२.१॥
verses.transliteration: tāṁ śrutvā karuṇāṁ vācaṁ piturmaraṇasaṁhitām ।rāghavo bharatenoktāṁ babhūva gatacetana: ॥ 2.102.1॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of Bharata regarding the death of his father, Rama became unconscious.
translations.hindi: अयोध्याकाण्ड का सत्तानवेवाँ सग समाप्त हुआ । . +#- | अष्टनवतितमः सगः निवेश्य सेनां तु विश्व) पड़यां पादवतांर वरः । अभिगन्त्‌ स काङुर्स्थमियेष शरुवतिनम्‌ २६

verses.sloka: तं तु वज्रमिवोत्सृष्टमाहवे दानवारिणा ।वाग्वज्रं भरतेनोक्तममनोज्ञं परन्तप: ॥ २.१०२.२॥
verses.transliteration: taṁ tu vajramivotsṛṣṭamāhave dānavāriṇā ।vāgvajraṁ bharatenoktamamanojñaṁ parantapa: ॥ 2.102.2॥

translations.english: On hearing the thunderlike words spoken by Bharata afflicting the mind, like the thunderbolt hurled by Indra (enemy of demons) in a battle, Rama, the scorcher of enemies, stretching forth both his arms, fell down on the ground like a tree with flowering tops severed by an axe in the forest.
translations.hindi: भरत जी फे आज्ञानुसार जब सेना ठहर गई तत्र भरत जी ने शत्र॒घ्र से कहा,

verses.sloka: प्रगृह्य बाहू रामो वै पुष्पिताग्रो यथा द्रुम: ।वने परशुना कृत्तस्तथा भुवि पपात ह ॥ २.१०२.३॥
verses.transliteration: pragṛhya bāhū rāmo vai puṣpitāgro yathā druma: ।vane paraśunā kṛttastathā bhuvi papāta ha ॥ 2.102.3॥

translations.english: On hearing the thunderlike words spoken by Bharata afflicting the mind, like the thunderbolt hurled by Indra (enemy of demons) in a battle, Rama, the scorcher of enemies, stretching forth both his arms, fell down on the ground like a tree with flowering tops severed by an axe in the forest.

verses.sloka: तथा निपतितं रामं जगत्यां जगतीपतिम् ।कूलघातपरिश्रान्तं प्रसुप्तमिव कुञ्जरम् ॥ २.१०२.४॥
verses.transliteration: tathā nipatitaṁ rāmaṁ jagatyāṁ jagatīpatim ।kūlaghātapariśrāntaṁ prasuptamiva kuñjaram ॥ 2.102.4॥

translations.english: On hearing the thunderlike words spoken by Bharata afflicting the mind, like the thunderbolt hurled by Indra (enemy of demons) in a battle, Rama, the scorcher of enemies, stretching forth both his arms, fell down on the ground like a tree with flowering tops severed by an axe in the forest.

verses.sloka: भ्रातरस्ते महेष्वासं सर्वत: शोककर्शितम् ।रुदन्त: सह वैदेह्या सिषिचु: सलिलेन वै ॥ २.१०२.५॥
verses.transliteration: bhrātaraste maheṣvāsaṁ sarvata: śokakarśitam ।rudanta: saha vaidehyā siṣicu: salilena vai ॥ 2.102.5॥

translations.english: Those brothers on all sides, with Sita lamenting, sprinkled water on Rama, the great archer and lord of the earth who, afflicted with grief, had fallen down on the ground, and was lying like an elephant exhausted from repeatedly striking a river bank.
translations.hindi: बोलने वालों में श्रेष्ठ महात्मा.भरत जी पव त के शिखरों पर लगे हुए फूले फले वृक्षा के बीच में जा पहुँचे

verses.sloka: स तु संज्ञां पुनर्लब्ध्वा नेत्राभ्यामास्रमुत्सृजन् ।उपाक्रामत काकुत्स्थ: कृपणं बहु भाषितुम् ॥ २.१०२.६॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu saṁjñāṁ punarlabdhvā netrābhyāmāsramutsṛjan ।upākrāmata kākutstha: kṛpaṇaṁ bahu bhāṣitum ॥ 2.102.6॥

translations.english: On regaining consciousness, shedding tears profusely, Rama again started speaking piteously.
translations.hindi: यावन्न राज्ये राज्याहः पिठपैतामहे स्थितः अभिपेकजलकिल्न्नो न मे शान्तिभत्रिष्यति ॥ & ॥ जब तक राज्य करने योग्य राम के उस पितृपितामह के राज्य पर अभिषेक के जल से आद्र ( भींगे न होंगे, तब तक सेरा जी ठिकाने न होगा

verses.sloka: स राम: स्वर्गतं श्रुत्वा पितरं पृथिवीपतिम् ।उवाच भरतं वाक्यं धर्मात्मा धर्मसंहितम् ॥ २.१०२.७॥
verses.transliteration: sa rāma: svargataṁ śrutvā pitaraṁ pṛthivīpatim ।uvāca bharataṁ vākyaṁ dharmātmā dharmasaṁhitam ॥ 2.102.7॥

translations.english: On hearing that his father, king Dasaratha, the lord of the world had attained heaven, righteous Rama said to Bharata in conformty with his rightful conduct.

verses.sloka: किं करिष्याम्ययोध्यायां ताते दिष्टां गतिं गते ।कस्तां राजवराद्धीनामयोध्यां पालयिष्यति ॥ २.१०२.८॥
verses.transliteration: kiṁ kariṣyāmyayodhyāyāṁ tāte diṣṭāṁ gatiṁ gate ।kastāṁ rājavarāddhīnāmayodhyāṁ pālayiṣyati ॥ 2.102.8॥

translations.english: What shall I do in Ayodhya now that my father has followed the path ordained by the gods? Who will rule that Ayodhya deprived of that best of kings?
translations.hindi: जब सक मैं भाई के राजचिहों से युक्त चरणयुगल अपने मस्तक पर धारण न कर लूँगा, तब तक मेरा मन शान्त न होगा

verses.sloka: किं नु तस्य मया कार्य्यं दुर्जातेन महात्मन: ।यो मृतो मम शोकेन मया चापि न संस्कृत: ॥ २.१०२.९॥
verses.transliteration: kiṁ nu tasya mayā kāryyaṁ durjātena mahātmana: ।yo mṛto mama śokena mayā cāpi na saṁskṛta: ॥ 2.102.9॥

translations.english: I could not even perform the last rites of that magnanimous one who died of grief on account of me. What use is my life with an unlucky birth?

verses.sloka: अहो भरत सिद्धार्थो येन राजा त्वया ऽनघ ।शत्रुघ्नेन च सर्वेषु प्रेतकृत्येषु सत्कृत: ॥ २.१०२.१०॥
verses.transliteration: aho bharata siddhārtho yena rājā tvayā 'nagha ।śatrughnena ca sarveṣu pretakṛtyeṣu satkṛta: ॥ 2.102.10॥

translations.english: O irreproachable Bharata, it is gratifying that you and Satrughna are indeed fortunate to have fulfilled your cherished desire since the king was wellhonoured by you with all the obsequial rites.
translations.hindi: सिद्धाथः खलु सौमित्रियश्चन्द्रविमलोपमम्‌ । सुखं पश्यति रामस्य राजीवाक्षे महाद्यति १० ॥ धन्य है लक्ष्मण, जो राम के उस निर्मल चम्द्रोपम मह।द्यति युक्त एव कमल सश नेत्र वाले मुख को, देखा करता है

verses.sloka: निष्प्रधानामनेकाग्रां नरेन्द्रेण विना कृताम् ।निवृत्तवनवासोपि नायोध्यां गन्तुमुत्सहे ॥ २.१०२.११॥
verses.transliteration: niṣpradhānāmanekāgrāṁ narendreṇa vinā kṛtām ।nivṛttavanavāsopi nāyodhyāṁ gantumutsahe ॥ 2.102.11॥

translations.english: Even after the completion of my exile I do not wish to return to Ayodhya which is directionless, bereft of its chief, the king.

verses.sloka: समाप्तवनवासं मामयोध्यायां परन्तप ।को नु शासिष्यति पुनस्ताते लोकान्तरं गते ॥ २.१०२.१२॥
verses.transliteration: samāptavanavāsaṁ māmayodhyāyāṁ parantapa ।ko nu śāsiṣyati punastāte lokāntaraṁ gate ॥ 2.102.12॥

translations.english: O subduer of enemies, when father has gone to the other world, who will guide me in Ayodhya after I complete my term of exile?
translations.hindi: हिमालय पव त के समान यह चित्रकूट पवत भी धन्य हे । क्योंकि इस पर राम उसी प्रकार वास करते हैं, जिस प्रकार कुवेर चैत्ररथ वन सें

verses.sloka: पुरा प्रेक्ष्य सुवृत्तं मां पिता यान्याह सान्त्वयन् ।वाक्यानि तानि श्रोष्यामि कुत: कर्णसुखान्यहम् ॥ २.१०२.१३॥
verses.transliteration: purā prekṣya suvṛttaṁ māṁ pitā yānyāha sāntvayan ।vākyāni tāni śroṣyāmi kuta: karṇasukhānyaham ॥ 2.102.13॥

translations.english: On seeing my good conduct our father used to say comforting words to me. Now from whom can I hear such words pleasing to the ears?
translations.hindi: यह्‌ बन जो सर्पो से भरा होने के कारण, दुर्गम है, कृतार्थ हुआ क्योंकि इसमें शस्र चलाने वालों में भ्रष्ठ, राम रहते हुँ

verses.sloka: एवमुक्त्वा स भरतं भार्यामभ्येत्य राघव: ।उवाच शोकसन्तप्त: पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम् ॥ २.१०२.१४॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā sa bharataṁ bhāryāmabhyetya rāghava: ।uvāca śokasantapta: pūrṇacandranibhānanām ॥ 2.102.14॥

translations.english: Having thus spoken to Bharata, Rama, overwhelmed with grief, approached his wife Sita whose face looked like the full Moon, and said to her.
translations.hindi: तब तो भरत जी अपने बान्धवों सहित हर्षित हुए और यहीं रहते इँ--यह निश्चय कर, मानौं सुदर के पार हो गए

verses.sloka: सीते मृतस्ते श्वशुर: पित्रा हीनो ऽसि लक्ष्मण ।भरतो दु:खमाचष्टे स्वर्गतं पृथिवीपतिम् ॥ २.१०२.१५॥
verses.transliteration: sīte mṛtaste śvaśura: pitrā hīno 'si lakṣmaṇa ।bharato du:khamācaṣṭe svargataṁ pṛthivīpatim ॥ 2.102.15॥

translations.english: O Sita, your fatherinlaw is dead. O Lakshmana, you are deprived of your father. Bharata is relating to me the sad news that king Dasaratha has attained his heavenly abode.

verses.sloka: ततो बहुगुणं तेषां बाष्पं नेत्रेष्वजायत ।तथा ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे कुमाराणां यशस्विनाम् ॥ २.१०२.१६॥
verses.transliteration: tato bahuguṇaṁ teṣāṁ bāṣpaṁ netreṣvajāyata ।tathā bruvati kākutsthe kumārāṇāṁ yaśasvinām ॥ 2.102.16॥

translations.english: While the scion of the Kakutsthas was saying thus, copious tears welled up from the eyes of all those illustrious sons of Dasaratha.
translations.hindi: भरत ने वहाँ एक साखू के वृक्ष के ऊपर लड़ कर श्रीराम चन्दे के आश्रम में जलती हुई अग्नि का बहुत ऊंचा उठता हुआ छुझओं देखा

verses.sloka: ततस्ते भ्रातर: सर्वे भृशमाश्वास्य राघवम् ।अब्रुवन् जगतीभर्त्तु: क्रियतामुदकं पितु: ॥ २.१०२.१७॥
verses.transliteration: tataste bhrātara: sarve bhṛśamāśvāsya rāghavam ।abruvan jagatībharttu: kriyatāmudakaṁ pitu: ॥ 2.102.17॥

translations.english: All the brothers, having consoled Rama as best they could, told him, Let the libations be offered to our father, the protector of the world.

verses.sloka: सा सीता श्वशुरं श्रुत्वा स्वर्गलोकगतं नृपम् ।नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यामशकन्नेक्षितुं पतिम् ॥ २.१०२.१८॥
verses.transliteration: sā sītā śvaśuraṁ śrutvā svargalokagataṁ nṛpam ।netrābhyāmaśrupūrṇābhyāmaśakannekṣituṁ patim ॥ 2.102.18॥

translations.english: On hearing that her fatherinlaw, king Dasaratha, had attained heaven, Sita, her eyes filled with tears could not look at her husband in the face.

verses.sloka: सान्त्वयित्वा तु तां रामो रुदन्तीं जनकात्मजाम् ।उवाच लक्ष्मणं तत्र दु:खितो दु:खितं वच: ॥ २.१०२.१९॥
verses.transliteration: sāntvayitvā tu tāṁ rāmo rudantīṁ janakātmajām ।uvāca lakṣmaṇaṁ tatra du:khito du:khitaṁ vaca: ॥ 2.102.19॥

translations.english: Having consoled Sita, daughter of Janaka, griefstricken Rama said to Lakshmana who was also distressed with grief.

verses.sloka: आनयेङ्गुदिपिण्याकं चीरमाहर चोत्तरम् ।जलक्रियार्थं तातस्य गमिष्यामि महात्मन: ॥ २.१०२.२०॥
verses.transliteration: ānayeṅgudipiṇyākaṁ cīramāhara cottaram ।jalakriyārthaṁ tātasya gamiṣyāmi mahātmana: ॥ 2.102.20॥

translations.english: I shall go and offer libations to my magnanimous father. Go and fetch the dried pulp of ingudi fruit and an upper garment made of bark.

verses.sloka: सीता पुरस्ताद्व्रजतुत्वमेनामभितो व्रज ।अहं पश्चाद्गमिष्यामि गतिर्ह्येषा सुदारुणा ॥ २.१०२.२१॥
verses.transliteration: sītā purastādvrajatutvamenāmabhito vraja ।ahaṁ paścādgamiṣyāmi gatirhyeṣā sudāruṇā ॥ 2.102.21॥

translations.english: Let us proceed in this order -- you first, Sita second and I last. This procession in mourning is terrible indeed.

verses.sloka: ततो नित्यानुगस्तेषां विदितात्मा महामति: ।मृदुर्दान्तश्च शान्तश्च रामे च दृढभक्तिमान् ॥ २.१०२.२२॥
verses.transliteration: tato nityānugasteṣāṁ viditātmā mahāmati: ।mṛdurdāntaśca śāntaśca rāme ca dṛḍhabhaktimān ॥ 2.102.22॥

translations.english: Thereafter, their constant follower Sumantra who was conversant in spiritual knowledge, a highminded person, softnatured, selfcontrolled, tranquilminded and staunchly devoted to Rama consoled him. Holding the hands of the princes, Sumantra helped their descent into the auspicious river Mandakini for taking bath.

verses.sloka: सुमन्त्रस्तैर्नृपसुतै: सार्द्धमाश्वास्य राघवम् ।अवातारयदालम्ब्य नदीं मन्दाकिनीं शिवाम् ॥ २.१०२.२३॥
verses.transliteration: sumantrastairnṛpasutai: sārddhamāśvāsya rāghavam ।avātārayadālambya nadīṁ mandākinīṁ śivām ॥ 2.102.23॥

translations.english: Thereafter, their constant follower Sumantra who was conversant in spiritual knowledge, a highminded person, softnatured, selfcontrolled, tranquilminded and staunchly devoted to Rama consoled him. Holding the hands of the princes, Sumantra helped their descent into the auspicious river Mandakini for taking bath.

verses.sloka: ते सुतीर्थां तत: कृच्छ्रादुपागम्य यशस्विन: ।नदीं मन्दाकिनीं रम्यां सदा पुष्पितकाननाम् ॥ २.१०२.२४॥
verses.transliteration: te sutīrthāṁ tata: kṛcchrādupāgamya yaśasvina: ।nadīṁ mandākinīṁ ramyāṁ sadā puṣpitakānanām ॥ 2.102.24॥

translations.english: The illustrious brothers approached with great difficulty the swiftflowing and enchanting river Mandakini which had convenient descent and endowed with forests always in bloom. They descended at an auspicious place that was not slushy and offered libations of water saying 'O father, let these offerings be yours'.

verses.sloka: शीघ्रस्रोतसमासाद्य तीर्थं शिवमकर्द्दमम् ।सिषिचुस्तूदकं राज्ञे तत्रैतत्ते भवत्विति ॥ २.१०२.२५॥
verses.transliteration: śīghrasrotasamāsādya tīrthaṁ śivamakarddamam ।siṣicustūdakaṁ rājñe tatraitatte bhavatviti ॥ 2.102.25॥

translations.english: The illustrious brothers approached with great difficulty the swiftflowing and enchanting river Mandakini which had convenient descent and endowed with forests always in bloom. They descended at an auspicious place that was not slushy and offered libations of water saying 'O father, let these offerings be yours'.

verses.sloka: प्रगृह्य च महीपालो जलपूरितमञ्जलिम् ।दिशं याम्यामभिमुखो रुदन् वचनमब्रवीत् ॥ २.१०२.२६॥
verses.transliteration: pragṛhya ca mahīpālo jalapūritamañjalim ।diśaṁ yāmyāmabhimukho rudan vacanamabravīt ॥ 2.102.26॥

translations.english: Rama, the ruler of the earth, held water with both palms cupped and, facing the south, the direction of Yama (the god of death) said these words, sobbing:

verses.sloka: एतत्ते राजशार्दूल विमलं तोयमक्षयम् ।पितृलोकगतस्याद्य मद्दत्तमुपतिष्ठतु ॥ २.१०२.२७॥
verses.transliteration: etatte rājaśārdūla vimalaṁ toyamakṣayam ।pitṛlokagatasyādya maddattamupatiṣṭhatu ॥ 2.102.27॥

translations.english: 'O best of kings, you are gone to the world of the manes, and let this inexhaustible libation of pure water reach you'.

verses.sloka: ततो मन्दाकिनीतीरात् प्रत्युत्तीर्य्य स राघव: ।पितुश्चकार तेजस्वी निवापं भ्रातृभि: सह ॥ २.१०२.२८॥
verses.transliteration: tato mandākinītīrāt pratyuttīryya sa rāghava: ।pituścakāra tejasvī nivāpaṁ bhrātṛbhi: saha ॥ 2.102.28॥

translations.english: Then, the powerful scion of the Raghu race reached bank, from the bathing spot of the river Mandakini along with his brothers and offered pinda (an offering of rice flour to the departed) to his late lamented father.

verses.sloka: ऐङ्गुदं बदरीमिश्रं पिण्याकं दर्भसंस्तरे ।न्यस्य राम: सुदु:खार्त्तो रुदन् वचनमब्रवीत् ॥ २.१०२.२९॥
verses.transliteration: aiṅgudaṁ badarīmiśraṁ piṇyākaṁ darbhasaṁstare ।nyasya rāma: sudu:khārtto rudan vacanamabravīt ॥ 2.102.29॥

translations.english: Placing the balls of ingudi pulp mixed with badari fruit on a spread of darbha grass, Rama, was overcome with grief and weeping, said:

verses.sloka: इदं भुङ्क्ष्व महाराज प्रीतो यदशना वयम् ।यदन्न: पुरुषो भवति तदन्नास्तस्य देवता: ॥ २.१०२.३०॥
verses.transliteration: idaṁ bhuṅkṣva mahārāja prīto yadaśanā vayam ।yadanna: puruṣo bhavati tadannāstasya devatā: ॥ 2.102.30॥

translations.english: O great king, we offer you such food as we partake now. Be pleased to accept it. For, his gods are offered the food a man takes.

verses.sloka: ततस्तेनैव मार्गेण प्रत्युत्तीर्य्य नदीतटात् ।आरुरोह नरव्याघ्रो रम्यसानुं महीधरम् ॥ २.१०२.३१॥
verses.transliteration: tatastenaiva mārgeṇa pratyuttīryya nadītaṭāt ।āruroha naravyāghro ramyasānuṁ mahīdharam ॥ 2.102.31॥

translations.english: Rama, the tiger among men, ascending the riverbank and proceeding on the same path (he had come), climbed the (Chitrakuta) mountain of charming slopes.

verses.sloka: तत: पर्णकुटीद्वारमासाद्य जगतीपति: ।परिजग्राह बाहुभ्यामुभौ भरतलक्ष्मणौ ॥ २.१०२.३२॥
verses.transliteration: tata: parṇakuṭīdvāramāsādya jagatīpati: ।parijagrāha bāhubhyāmubhau bharatalakṣmaṇau ॥ 2.102.32॥

translations.english: Rama, lord of the earth, reached the door of the leafhut and took Bharata and Lakshmana in his arms.

verses.sloka: तेषां तु रुदतां शब्दात् प्रतिश्रुत्को ऽभवद्गिरौ ।भ्रातऽणां सह वैदेह्या: सिंहानामिव नर्दताम् ॥ २.१०२.३३॥
verses.transliteration: teṣāṁ tu rudatāṁ śabdāt pratiśrutko 'bhavadgirau ।bhrāta'ṇāṁ saha vaidehyā: siṁhānāmiva nardatām ॥ 2.102.33॥

translations.english: The mountain echoed with the sound of lamentations of all the brothers along with Sita which resembled the roar of lions.

verses.sloka: महाबलानां रुदतां कुर्वतामुदकं पितु: ।विज्ञाय तुमुलं शब्दं त्रस्ता भरतसैनिका: ॥ २.१०२.३४॥
verses.transliteration: mahābalānāṁ rudatāṁ kurvatāmudakaṁ pitu: ।vijñāya tumulaṁ śabdaṁ trastā bharatasainikā: ॥ 2.102.34॥

translations.english: The soldiers of Bharata were alarmed on hearing the tumultuous sounds raised by those mighty brothers offering libations of water and lamenting.

verses.sloka: अब्रुवंश्चापि रामेण भरत: सङ्गतो ध्रुवम् ।तेषामेव महाञ्छब्द: शोचतां पितरं मृतम् ॥ २.१०२.३५॥
verses.transliteration: abruvaṁścāpi rāmeṇa bharata: saṅgato dhruvam ।teṣāmeva mahāñchabda: śocatāṁ pitaraṁ mṛtam ॥ 2.102.35॥

translations.english: They said, 'Bharata must have joined Rama. That loud noise must be their wailing over their deceased father'.

verses.sloka: अथ वासान् परित्यज्य तं सर्वे ऽभिमुखा: स्वनम् ।अप्येकमनसो जग्मुर्यथास्थानं प्रधाविता: ॥ २.१०२.३६॥
verses.transliteration: atha vāsān parityajya taṁ sarve 'bhimukhā: svanam ।apyekamanaso jagmuryathāsthānaṁ pradhāvitā: ॥ 2.102.36॥

translations.english: Then all of them left their camps with one single thought (of seeing Rama) in their minds and ran in the direction from where that sound emanated.

verses.sloka: हयैरन्ये गजैरन्ये रथैरन्ये स्वलङ्कृतै: ।सुकुमारास्तथैवान्ये पद्भिरेव नरा ययु: ॥ २.१०२.३७॥
verses.transliteration: hayairanye gajairanye rathairanye svalaṅkṛtai: ।sukumārāstathaivānye padbhireva narā yayu: ॥ 2.102.37॥

translations.english: Some rode horses, some, elephants, while others mounted welldecorated chariots, while the young went on foot.

verses.sloka: अचिरप्रोषितं रामं चिरविप्रोषितं यथा ।द्रष्टुकामो जन: सर्वो जगाम सहसाश्रमम् ॥ २.१०२.३८॥
verses.transliteration: aciraproṣitaṁ rāmaṁ ciraviproṣitaṁ yathā ।draṣṭukāmo jana: sarvo jagāma sahasāśramam ॥ 2.102.38॥

translations.english: The whole multitude of people at once rushed towards the hermitage wishing to see Rama as if he had left long ago though he had gone on exile very recently.

verses.sloka: भ्रातऽणां त्वरितास्तत्र द्रष्टुकामा: समागमम् ।ययुर्बहुविधैर्यानै: खुरनेमिस्वनाकुलै: ॥ २.१०२.३९॥
verses.transliteration: bhrāta'ṇāṁ tvaritāstatra draṣṭukāmā: samāgamam ।yayurbahuvidhairyānai: khuranemisvanākulai: ॥ 2.102.39॥

translations.english: Eager to see the union of brothers, all those people went by every sort of vehicle filled with the sounds of hooves and wheels.

verses.sloka: सा भूमिर्बहुभिर्यानै: खुरनेमिसमाहता ।मुमोच तुमुलं शब्दं द्यौरिवाभ्रसमागमे ॥ २.१०२.४०॥
verses.transliteration: sā bhūmirbahubhiryānai: khuranemisamāhatā ।mumoca tumulaṁ śabdaṁ dyaurivābhrasamāgame ॥ 2.102.40॥

translations.english: The earth crushed by several vehicles, hooves (of horses) and wheels (of chariots) emitted tumultuous sounds like the sky in the gathering stormclouds.

verses.sloka: तेन वित्रासिता नागा: करेणुपरिवारिता: ।आवासयन्तो गन्धेन जग्मुरन्यद्वनं तत: ॥ २.१०२.४१॥
verses.transliteration: tena vitrāsitā nāgā: kareṇuparivāritā: ।āvāsayanto gandhena jagmuranyadvanaṁ tata: ॥ 2.102.41॥

translations.english: Frightened by the sound, the elephants followed by their females, spreading all the way the odour of the ichor, moved to other forests.

verses.sloka: वराहवृकसङ्घाश्च महिषा: सर्प्पवानरा: ।व्याघ्रगोकर्णगवया: वित्रेसु: पृषतैः सह ॥ २.१०२.४२॥
verses.transliteration: varāhavṛkasaṅghāśca mahiṣā: sarppavānarā: ।vyāghragokarṇagavayā: vitresu: pṛṣataiḥ saha ॥ 2.102.42॥

translations.english: Hearing that sound, hosts of boars and deer, buffaloes, serpents and apes, tigers, antelopes with ears like the cows', gavayas as well as dappled antelopes were all frightened.

verses.sloka: रथाङ्गसाह्वा नत्यूहा: हंसा: कारण्डवा: प्लवा: ।तथा पुंस्कोकिला: क्रौञ्चा विसंज्ञा भेजिरे दिश: ॥ २.१०२.४३॥
verses.transliteration: rathāṅgasāhvā natyūhā: haṁsā: kāraṇḍavā: plavā: ।tathā puṁskokilā: krauñcā visaṁjñā bhejire diśa: ॥ 2.102.43॥

translations.english: Ducks, watercranes, geese, karandavas, cranes, male cuckoos and kraunchas fled senselessly in different directions.

verses.sloka: तेन शब्देन वित्रस्तैराकाशं पक्षिभिर्वृतम् ।मनुष्यैरावृता भूमिरुभयं प्रबभौ तदा ॥ २.१०२.४४॥
verses.transliteration: tena śabdena vitrastairākāśaṁ pakṣibhirvṛtam ।manuṣyairāvṛtā bhūmirubhayaṁ prababhau tadā ॥ 2.102.44॥

translations.english: The sky was filled with birds frightened by the sound and the earth covered with people. Both looked extremely beautiful.

verses.sloka: ततस्तं पुरुषव्याघ्रं यशस्विनमरिन्दमम् ।आसीनं स्थण्डिले रामं ददर्श सहसा जन: ॥ २.१०२.४५॥
verses.transliteration: tatastaṁ puruṣavyāghraṁ yaśasvinamarindamam ।āsīnaṁ sthaṇḍile rāmaṁ dadarśa sahasā jana: ॥ 2.102.45॥

translations.english: All at once the people saw the illustrious Rama, the best of men, and the subduer of enemies squatting on the bare earth.

verses.sloka: विगर्हमाण: कैकेयीं सहितो मन्थरामपि ।अभिगम्य जनो रामं बाष्पपूर्णमुखो ऽभवत् ॥ २.१०२.४६॥
verses.transliteration: vigarhamāṇa: kaikeyīṁ sahito mantharāmapi ।abhigamya jano rāmaṁ bāṣpapūrṇamukho 'bhavat ॥ 2.102.46॥

translations.english: All those men with faces full of tears, reproaching Kaikeyi and Manthara (all the way), approached Rama.

verses.sloka: तान्नरान् बाष्पपूर्णाक्षान् समीक्ष्याथ सुदु:खितान् ।पर्य्यष्वजत धर्मज्ञ: पितृवन्मातृवच्च स: ॥ २.१०२.४७॥
verses.transliteration: tānnarān bāṣpapūrṇākṣān samīkṣyātha sudu:khitān ।paryyaṣvajata dharmajña: pitṛvanmātṛvacca sa: ॥ 2.102.47॥

translations.english: Thereafter, beholding those people deeply afflicted, their eyes full of tears, Rama embraced them as if they were his own father and mother.

verses.sloka: स तत्र कांच्चित् परिषस्वजे नरान्नराश्च केचित्तु तमभ्यवादयन् ।चकार सर्वान् सवयस्य बान्धवान् यथार्हमासाद्य तदा नृपात्मज: ॥ २.१०२.४८॥
verses.transliteration: sa tatra kāṁccit pariṣasvaje narānnarāśca kecittu tamabhyavādayan ।cakāra sarvān savayasya bāndhavān yathārhamāsādya tadā nṛpātmaja: ॥ 2.102.48॥

translations.english: Rama embraced some, while others paid him obeisance. Therafter, he honoured his erstwhile companions and relations in accordance with their status.

verses.sloka: स तत्र तेषां रुदतां महात्मनां भुवं च खं चानुनिनादयन् स्वन: ।गुहा गिरीणां च दिशश्च सन्ततं मृदङ्गघोषप्रतिम: प्रशुश्रुवे ॥ २.१०२.४९ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tatra teṣāṁ rudatāṁ mahātmanāṁ bhuvaṁ ca khaṁ cānuninādayan svana: ।guhā girīṇāṁ ca diśaśca santataṁ mṛdaṅgaghoṣapratima: praśuśruve ॥ 2.102.49 ॥

translations.english: The weeping and the tumult of those magnanimous people made the earth, sky, mountaincaves and all quarters reverberate incessantly like the beating of drums. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्व्युत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the hundred and second sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
